content.name: Harpreet Sandhu
content.title: DevOps Engineer (Azure)
content.summary: DevOps engineer with nine years in Calgary, from pipeline-data support in the energy sector to running Azure infrastructure for a virtual-care provider. Built the AKS platform behind 400,000 telehealth visits a year while keeping patient data in Canadian regions. Strong on GitHub Actions, Terraform and cost control.

experience.title: Junior Systems Analyst
bullets: Supported Windows and Linux servers hosting SCADA data historians for 18 field operators.
Scripted nightly backups and restore tests in PowerShell, replacing a manual checklist that was often skipped.
Cut ticket backlog from 90 to 25 by building a self-service password and VPN reset page.

experience.title: Cloud Operations Engineer
bullets: Migrated 35 point-of-sale back-office services to Azure App Service, closing the on-premises server room.
Introduced Terraform and Azure DevOps pipelines, reducing environment drift incidents from monthly to rare.
Set up Azure Monitor alerting that caught a payment gateway slowdown on Boxing Day before stores escalated.
Trained the support desk on reading dashboards so they could triage before paging engineers.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
bullets: Built and run the AKS platform behind roughly 400,000 virtual visits a year, hosted only in Canada Central and Canada East to meet data-residency commitments.
Moved CI/CD to GitHub Actions with reusable workflows, cutting median pipeline time from 24 to 9 minutes.
Reduced monthly Azure spend by $18,000 through reserved instances and scheduling non-production clusters off overnight.
Run quarterly disaster-recovery drills and mentor one junior engineer on Kubernetes troubleshooting.

achievements.title: Volunteer, Calgary tech mentorship program
achievements.detail: Mentored three newcomers to Canada into cloud support roles.

achievements.title: Internal reliability award, Foothills Telehealth
achievements.detail: Recognised for keeping the platform available through a 3x demand spike during a flu season.
